minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  September 30, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Council Chambers, 9th floor at
11:34 a.m.:

  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk Department
  Ken Campos, City Attorney Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department

  Staff Present:  Sabrina Barnes, Parks and Recreation
  Fred Jackson, Planning
  Markland Watson, Fleet Services

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Member Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of September 23, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Stone Planning LLC – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  payment for the analytical work provided to Planning of $4,324.73. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  3. South Bay Ford – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  payment for providing repairs on city vehicles in the amount of $2,874.25. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  4. Tabri Lake Music - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  payment for the provision of a musical sketch in the amount of $1,000.00. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  5. Dawn Norfleet Music - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the
  recommended payment for the provision of a musical sketch in the amount of
  $1,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Member Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 12:00 p.m. Adjournment
